https://mastodon.social/@73CC@social.tch.name: TECC
https://mastodon.social/@73CC@social.tch.text: Me, right now. 10 days left until 04.11.2026. 🫪 For twenty years I was immune to every single #WoW expansion. #Retail does not reach me at all anymore, and the worst part is not the game itself. People rush their quests, run their #Dungeons in silence and leave without a word. Fast, efficient, empty. Then I took one look at #WoWForever and I am the guy from 2004 again, the one who does not go to bed. No idea if it will hold up. But I have not felt this since #Vanilla, #TBC, and that says a lot about what modern #MMO design lost on the way. #ForTheHorde! #Gaming #Blizzard #Games #MMORPG
